evals.prompt: Build me a Microsoft Form survey for our Q3 field-tech pulse. Grill me first, then create it in Forms.
evals.expected_output: Should load ms-forms-survey-builder. Should grill one question at a time using the interview tree (decision, audience, access, length, topics). Should not create the Form until a survey spec is shown and explicitly approved. After approval, should write a spec JSON and run ms_forms_client.py create. Should return designer + respond URLs.
assertions: Triggers ms-forms-survey-builder (not only grill-me)
Asks one grill question at a time
Gives a recommended answer with each question
Drafts a survey spec before create
Waits for explicit approval before calling create
Uses scripts/ms_forms_client.py for Form creation
Returns a DesignPageV2 designer URL on success

evals.prompt: Create an anonymous 5-question NPS form for internal employees. Decision: whether to invest in tooling next quarter. Max 3 minutes.
evals.expected_output: Should skip already-answered grill branches (decision, audience, anonymity, length). Should draft a short NPS-led spec (NPS + influencing factor + optional open text). Should keep <=5-8 questions. Should show the outline for approval before create.
assertions: Skips resolved grill branches
Includes an NPS question as primary metric
Keeps the survey short (<=8 questions)
Respects anonymous / internal constraints in the draft
Shows draft for approval before create

evals.prompt: I need a training feedback form with a Likert for each module — put it straight into Microsoft Forms.
evals.expected_output: Should still draft-then-approve (never skip approval). Should mark Likert as type manual in the spec and remind the user to add it in the designer after auto-create. Should auto-create rating/choice/text questions. Should not claim Graph officially supports Forms create.
assertions: Does not skip draft approval
Marks Likert as manual in the spec
Explains Likert must be added in the designer
Auto-creates supported question types only
Does not claim official Graph Forms create support

evals.prompt: forms.cloud.microsoft DesignPage — help me design a quick event RSVP and configure it.
evals.expected_output: Should trigger on DesignPage / Forms URL language. Should grill lightly then produce an RSVP-shaped spec (attendance choice, optional dietary, open comment). After approval, create via the client script or dry-run if auth is blocked, with a clear manual fallback.
assertions: Triggers on Forms/DesignPage language
Produces an RSVP-shaped question set
Uses create script after approval
Provides manual fallback if auth fails
